items.title: Plas Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: Yeah I was with the first band... Buster Cooper, Benny Powell. It was fun playing.

ctx.x: You were part of the Jauggernaut?

Yeah I was with the first band, yeah. Richie Kamuca was the other tenor and mostly the same players that he has right now. Marshall Royal was first alto. Buster Cooper, Benny Powell. It was fun playing.
